verdict.rationale: Fly.io's Machines/Sprites provide fast-launching, hardware-isolated VMs that can scale out to thousands of instances, and features like per-agent Sprites (docs-4/5/6) and fast `fly machine run`/`fly launch` (docs-16/27) support spinning up many isolated environments for parallel work. However, there's no explicit 'unlimited' guarantee, and multiple independent hands-on reports describe reliability problems (stuck/unreachable machines, flaky deploys, outages affecting staging/production) that would undermine a team's ability to reliably ship simultaneously at scale. Missing for 10: an explicit 'unlimited' or team-collaboration framing, and stronger independent corroboration that concurrent environment creation is reliable at scale.
